**To:** All staff, Zurich office\
**From:** Claudia Steiner, Head of Operations\
**Date:** 4 November 2026\
**Subject:** Office move to Hardturmstrasse on 11–12 December

---

Dear colleagues,

As announced at the October all-hands, we are moving to our new office at Hardturmstrasse 161 in December. This memo sets out what happens when, and what we need from you. Please read it in full; it replaces the draft schedule shared in September.

## Key dates

| Date | What happens |
|---|---|
| Fri 28 Nov | Moving boxes delivered to every desk |
| Wed 10 Dec, 17:00 | Last day at Limmatquai; all boxes packed and labelled |
| Thu 11 – Fri 12 Dec | Office closed; please work from home |
| Mon 15 Dec, 08:00 | New office opens |

The removal company will move furniture, screens and packed boxes on Thursday. IT will set up docking stations and the network on Friday, so that everything works when you arrive on Monday.

## What we need from you

- **Pack your desk** by Wednesday 10 December at 17:00, using the labels with your new desk number (in the box delivered on 28 November). Anything not packed and labelled will be stored, not moved.
- **Take your laptop home** on Wednesday evening and work from home on Thursday and Friday. Customer calls continue as normal through the softphone.
- **Clear the fridges and shared shelves** by Tuesday 9 December. Items left after that will be donated or disposed of.
- **Book a parking space** in the new building through the facilities portal if you need one. There are 24 spaces and 60 bicycle places; spaces are allocated on 1 December.

## On your first day

1. Collect your access badge at reception on the ground floor. Bring photo ID.
2. Find your desk on the floor plan sent with your badge confirmation; team areas are on the third and fourth floors.
3. Report anything missing or broken through the facilities portal, not by e-mail, so that we can track it.

The new office has more meeting rooms (14 instead of 6), a quiet zone on each floor, and a staff kitchen with seating for forty. It is a ten-minute walk from Hardbrücke station; trams 4 and 13 stop in front of the building.

I know a move in December is not ideal. We chose these dates because they are the quietest for our customers and because the landlord at Limmatquai needs the space from January. Thank you in advance for your help in making it go smoothly. If you have questions, ask your team's move coordinator or write to me directly.

Kind regards,

**Claudia Steiner**\
Head of Operations\
Brightwater Insurance Services AG

*cc: Executive board; move coordinators*
